postmortems.title: Redis lock starvation under peak traffic spike
postmortems.root_cause: Redis lock starvation: Critical section in locks.py threw unhandled database blip exception before reaching release() handle, causing locks to remain allocated indefinitely until Redis TTL expired.
postmortems.resolution_diff:
--- a/src/locks.py
+++ b/src/locks.py
@@ -14,5 +14,8 @@
     def process_critical_section(self, key: str, should_fail: bool = False):
         self.acquire(key)
+        try:
             if should_fail:
                 raise ValueError("Unexpected database network blip during processing")
+        finally:
+            self.release(key)

postmortems.title: JWT public key cache stampede on token verification burst
postmortems.root_cause: Missing singleflight mutex around JWKS URL fetch caused 2,400 concurrent upstream HTTP requests to IdP upon cache TTL expiry.
postmortems.resolution_diff:
--- a/src/jwks.py
+++ b/src/jwks.py
@@ -8,2 +8,4 @@
+from singleflight import Group
+g = Group()
-def get_key(kid): return fetch_key(kid)
+def get_key(kid): return g.do(kid, lambda: fetch_key(kid))

postmortems.title: Idempotency key duplicate race condition under mobile retry flood
postmortems.root_cause: Insert-then-commit gap in idempotency table allowed two concurrent webhook deliveries with the same key to charge card twice.

postmortems.title: Migration lock timeout on accounts table
postmortems.root_cause: DDL query without lock_timeout caused connection starvation.

postmortems.title: OOM eviction cascade: allkeys-lru evicted master replica heartbeats
postmortems.root_cause: Session cache expansion exceeded maxmemory; allkeys-lru evicted internal replication offset keys, causing cluster failover storm.
postmortems.resolution_diff: CONFIG SET maxmemory-policy volatile-lru; CONFIG SET maxmemory 14gb;

postmortems.title: gRPC deadline propagation cascade causing thread starvation in upstream gateway
postmortems.root_cause: Missing timeout budget subtraction on downstream payment calls caused gateway threads to wait 30s while client already disconnected.

uncertainties.observation: Spike in HTTP 504s could be caused by either Redis maxclients saturation (4096) or application-level deadlock in locks.py.
uncertainties.verification_step: Run 'pytest tests/test_locks.py' inside Daytona isolated sandbox to verify if locks leak locally without touching live Redis cluster.
